title: TSB fined £48.65m for operational resilience failings
excerpt: "a significant proportion of its 5.2 million customers were affected"; FCA £29.75m + PRA £18.9m = £48.65m after 30% discount; "The firm failed to plan for the IT migration properly."
limitations: Press release; detail taken from Final Notice XIN-002.

title: Final Notice: TSB Bank plc (FCA, 20 December 2022)
excerpt: "Testing only concluded the day before the decision to migrate was taken." 225,492 complaints (c.4.3% of customers); £32,705,762 redress; BAU not restored until 10 December 2018; SABIS relied on 85 third parties.
limitations: Read via pdftotext; sections on testing, outsourcing and summary read, not every paragraph.

title: TSB statement on publication of the Slaughter and May independent review
excerpt: Report identified "stronger oversight of suppliers and questions around how testing was carried out"; data centres "configured inconsistently despite having been specified to be identical"; Board disagrees with aspects.
limitations: Interested-party statement. The full Slaughter and May report PDF was downloaded but is image-only; text could not be extracted, so the report itself was NOT read.

title: TSB's IT disaster pinned on 'big bang' approach to migration (and similar coverage of the Slaughter and May report)
excerpt: Coverage quotes the report: platform "neither stable nor complete" at board approval; TSB "did not give sufficient consideration to whether a largely single event migration was the right choice"; no dedicated performance-test environment.
limitations: Secondary reporting of a report not read directly (see XIN-003); quotes not verified against original.

title: FINRA Rule 11870. Customer Account Transfer Contracts
excerpt: Carrying member validates or takes exception "within one business day"; completes transfer "within three business days following the validation"; exceptions permitted "only if" one of an enumerated list applies.
limitations: Rule text read; NSCC ACATS operating procedures not read.

title: ACATS: Increasing Opportunities to Decrease Risk
excerpt: Daily ACATS cycles increased from five to 11; "over 70% of full account transfers are now settling in four days" vs 60% before.
limitations: Seen via search excerpt only; DTCC is the operator (interested party). No current annual ACATS volume found.

title: The Charles Schwab Corporation Form 10-Q for quarter ended June 30, 2024
excerpt: "Over the course of five client transition groups, we converted approximately $1.9 trillion in client assets across more than 17 million client accounts, including 7,000 RIAs"; attrition "below our initial estimates"; total integration costs and capex expected $2.4-2.5 billion.
limitations: Integration cost covers the whole acquisition, not only client conversion.

title: Schwab reports no major issues after Labor Day weekend TD Ameritrade conversion
excerpt: Advisor-services wave (Labor Day 2023) moved >7,000 advisor firms, ~3.6m client accounts, ~$1.3T; minor issues such as positions not transferring exactly as expected and pricing issues.
limitations: Search excerpt only; trade press; figures partly attributed to Schwab executives.

title: Current Account Switch Guarantee
excerpt: "It will only take seven working days." "We will arrange for payments accidentally made to your old account to be automatically redirected... We will also contact the sender". Refund of interest and charges if anything goes wrong.
limitations: Scheme guarantee text; redirection period not stated in this document (bank documents say 36 months; Pay.UK says minimum three years).

title: The Current Account Switch Service reports 1.2 million switches in 2024
excerpt: 1,190,676 switches in 2024; "Almost all (99.7%) switches were completed within seven working days"; "the Service has successfully redirected 160.5 million payments".
limitations: Operator self-report of its own KPIs; methodology for 99.7% not stated on page.

title: CMA confirms full completion of Open Banking Roadmap
excerpt: Retail Banking Market Investigation Order 2017 required the nine largest providers to implement common open API standards; all nine completed the Roadmap by 9 September 2024.

title: Personal Financial Data Rights Reconsideration (ANPR)
excerpt: ANPR published 22 Aug 2025 (90 FR 40986; Docket CFPB-2025-0037); CFPB "is seeking comments and data to inform its consideration of four issues."
limitations: Page last modified Aug 2025; status after that (proposed rule, compliance-date changes, litigation stay in Forcht Bank v. CFPB) not verified as of 2026-11-26.

title: 29 CFR 2520.101-3. Notice of blackout periods under individual account plans
publisher: US Dept of Labor via Cornell LII
excerpt: Notice "at least 30 days, but not more than 60 days, in advance"; blackout = restriction "for any period of more than three consecutive business days"; notice must state reasons, rights affected, expected start/end.
limitations: ERISA plans only; not applicable to DAFs (analogy).

limitations: Payroll successor rules; analogy only for DAF acknowledgments/statements.
